# Mephibosheth at the King’s Table (2 Samuel 9:13)

## Emotional Focus
Feeling like you belong at the family table.

## Key KJV
“So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table.” (2 Samuel 9:13)

## Gentle Retelling
Mephibosheth felt scared because of his past, but King David invited him to eat at the palace table forever. He was treated like family.

## Coloring Prompt
Mephibosheth sitting at a royal table with David smiling kindly beside him.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You always belong at God’s table and in His family.”
